history.summary: A 1,259sqft 99-yr leasehold 4BR at Regent Grove, Yew Tee, asking $1,096 psf — a ~9% premium to the $1,002 URA median — but appreciating a strong 5.77%/yr on a deep 97-txn series, with Yew Tee MRT just 360m away. A 2000-build leasehold (~73 yrs left) at a very accessible $1.38M with genuine momentum and excellent transaction depth.
history.rating_rationale: Strong, reliable appreciation (5.77%/yr on 97 txn — the deepest series among the leasehold entries here), a low $1.38M absolute price squarely in HDB-upgrader territory, 360m to Yew Tee NS-line MRT, and ~73 years of lease remaining. The +9% premium to median is a fair cost for a large family unit close to the station; the deep buyer pool and accessible price make exit easy. The clearest value-for-money entry in this batch.
